property_summary: For every play call that pays the exact ticket amount, the reference contract only pays out and resets pot when the 2-way random outcome equals 0; the mutant flips the winning branch to random==1 so there exist inputs (i.e., msg.sender and block state producing random==1) where the mutant resets pot but the reference does not.
change_summary: Change the condition to random == 1 so winners occur on the opposite random outcome, altering when pot is paid out.
